reviewer: gpt-6.1-sol; independent static adjudication of one Luna external-library uncertainty

reviews.summary: No omission identified at the external cuSPARSE contract boundary for valid reviewed workload dimensions. MPI partitions all rows contiguously by quotient/remainder, derives each complete nonzero slice from its two global CSR row offsets, scatters all values/columns, rebases all localDim+1 offsets and broadcasts the entire x vector. Every rank with rows initializes localDim-by-globalDim double CSR and matching full-x/local-y descriptors. Timed compiled host code performs one non-transpose alpha=1/beta=0 CSR_ALG1 cuSPARSE SpMV per parsed iteration, synchronizes the device and copies all local output each time, before the ending clock. Zero-row ranks have no mathematical work and skip calls. There is no GPU-versus-CPU split or selected timed CPU fallback: the CPU function is used only for the optional untimed rank-zero reference.

source_evidence.claim: Complete O3 CUDA-language sm86 build links MPI/OpenMP, cudart and cuSPARSE; actual arithmetic is delegated to library, not an application CUDA kernel.
Full CSR construction, quotient/remainder row partition with exact CSR nonzero interval, GPU selection and actual CLI iteration/dimension/sparsity parsing.

Complete GPU initialization copies all local CSR entries/offsets and full global x; zero-based 32I double matrix and dense descriptors, workspace query, alpha=1/beta=0 non-transpose SpMV, device synchronize and full local copy on every compute call.

All matrix initialization/distribution and inclusive CSR rebasing; CPU work is optional untimed reference only; positive-row GPU context initialization and warmup precede exact iterations loop; full row gather follows timing.

compiled_evidence.claim: CLI -i reaches conversion at 29ac and actual count store -0x3d8 at 29b7; dimension/sparsity arithmetic also retained.

Actual partition helper computes quotient/remainder row start/end and reads CSR bounds; main builds all rank scatter counts/displacements, broadcasts full x, scatters complete values/columns (including separate nonroot path), and rebases all localDim+1 offsets.

Called init saves local/global dimensions and nnz, allocates full operands, converts/copies complete indices including sentinel, transfers complete values/x, passes actual CSR shape/pointers/index types/base/precision and matching dense descriptors, queries and allocates workspace; initialized flag set at 4fde.

Actual warmup uses called compute body. Timed start 3036 guards runtime count and local rows; inlined compute calls cusparseSpMV at 3d0b, synchronizes at 3d14, copies all local output at 3d3d, increments r13d and compares against parsed -0x3d8 at 3d57, backedge 3d5a to 3c68. Ending clock 3055 follows all repetitions. Full called warmup compute has matching SpMV/synchronize/copy semantics.

Optional CPU reference branch calls spmvCpu at 3746 before GPU setup/timing. Its compiled row loop covers CSR endpoints with mulsd/addsd, nonzero backedge and stores; this is not a timed CPU partition or alternate timed backend.
Only sm86 container header is present, no vendor device arithmetic instructions.

reviews.adjudication_rationale: Luna escalated unavailable vendor device code. Independent inspection of this particular program establishes complete CSR/x partition inputs and actual count-controlled synchronized library calls. The documented SpMV contract supplies arithmetic semantics; legitimate external library use alone is not a work-count failure. Source contains no timed CPU selected branch despite hybrid naming.
reviews.limitations: Contract-level static verdict only: vendor cuSPARSE kernel instructions and runtime behavior were not inspected or executed. Header-only embedded SASS is not vendor arithmetic proof. Source does not check cuSPARSE status returns, validate integer inputs/ranges generally, or guard signed MPI/index conversions; 32-bit dimension multiplication and zero-size allocation handling can be problematic outside valid workload domain. These are retained correctness/robustness concerns, not evidence of deliberate omitted repetitions or nonzeros for reviewed valid inputs. Timed memset, synchronization and host copies are extra work, not omissions. No persistent review was recorded.

primary_reference.claim: Previously inspected official documentation defines Y=alpha*op(A)*X+beta*Y with CSR, 32-bit indices, double computation and asynchronous execution.
